translationRepairs: Guang home with former Yingyin marquis grandson Pingye resided Lantian south mountain middle shot hunted.
Guang's household lived in seclusion with a grandson of the former Marquis of Yingyin in the mountains south of Lantian, where they went hunting.

In s0061, 屏野居 is the verb phrase “lived in seclusion,” not a personal name; the literal’s “Pingye” invents a name between 故潁陰侯孫 and 居藍田南山中, so the repair correctly restores seclusion and hunting with the marquis’s grandson.
But Gan had daughter as crown prince middle person, loved favored, Gan son Yu had favor with crown prince, but liked profit, Li clan Ling declined weakened.
But Gan had a daughter who was a palace woman of the Crown Prince and was favored; Gan's son Yu had favor with the Crown Prince, but liked profit, and the Li clan gradually declined and weakened.
In s0157, 陵遲衰微 means the Li clan “gradually declined and weakened”; 陵 is not Li Ling (who only appears in the next sentence 李陵既壯), so replacing “Ling declined” with gradual decline is required.
Wu Chu army time, Guang became fierce cavalry commandery governor, followed commander Ya fu attacked Wu Chu army, took flag, displayed merit fame Changyi below.
Wu-Chu army time, Guang became brave-cavalry commandant, followed Grand Commandant Yafu attacking Wu-Chu armies, took a flag, and displayed merit and fame below Changyi.
In s0011, 驍騎都尉 is a cavalry commandant, not a commandery governor, and 太尉亞夫 is Grand Commandant Yafu; the repair corrects both office and title misreadings without inventing content.
